import json, os, sys, glob

ALLOWED_STATUS = ["draft_required", "draft_ready", "prompt_locked",
                  "execution_completed", "human_approval_required", "blocked", "done"]
TRANSITIONS = {
    "draft_required": ["draft_ready", "blocked"],
    "draft_ready": ["prompt_locked", "blocked"],
    "prompt_locked": ["execution_completed", "blocked"],
    "execution_completed": ["human_approval_required", "blocked"],
    "human_approval_required": ["done", "prompt_locked", "blocked"],
    "blocked": ["draft_required", "draft_ready", "prompt_locked"],
    "done": [],
}
REQUIRED_KEYS = ["case_id", "title", "status", "updated_at", "updated_by", "links", "history"]

def main():
    files = sorted(glob.glob("tasks/status/*.json"))
    rows, problems = [], []
    for fp in files:
        try:
            data = json.load(open(fp, encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception as e:
            problems.append(f"{fp}: JSONとして読めない ({e})")
            continue
        for k in REQUIRED_KEYS:
            if k not in data:
                problems.append(f"{fp}: 必須キー {k} がない")
        st = data.get("status")
        if st not in ALLOWED_STATUS:
            problems.append(f"{fp}: 状態の値が不正 ({st})")
        hist = data.get("history", [])
        for h in hist:
            frm, to = h.get("from"), h.get("to")
            if frm in TRANSITIONS and to not in TRANSITIONS[frm]:
                problems.append(f"{fp}: 許可されていない遷移 {frm} -> {to}")
        if hist and hist[-1].get("to") != st:
            problems.append(f"{fp}: 現在の状態と履歴の最後が一致しない")
        if st == "execution_completed":
            dl = data.get("links", {}).get("deliverable", "")
            if not dl or not os.path.exists(dl):
                problems.append(f"{fp}: 納品物のリンク先がない ({dl})")
            else:
                body = open(dl, encoding="utf-8").read()
                for head in ["読み込み報告", "参照指定"]:
                    if head not in body:
                        problems.append(f"{fp}: 納品物に「{head}」が含まれていない")
        rows.append(data)
    lines = ["# 状態一覧（自動生成）", "",
             "| 案件 | 状態 | 更新 | 更新者 |", "|---|---|---|---|"]
    for d in rows:
        lines.append(f"| {d.get('title','')}（{d.get('case_id','')}） | {d.get('status','')} | {d.get('updated_at','')} | {d.get('updated_by','')} |")
    lines += ["", "## 検証結果", ""]
    if problems:
        lines.append("問題あり：")
        lines += [f"- {p}" for p in problems]
    else:
        lines.append("問題なし（全案件の状態・遷移・完備チェックを通過）")
    out = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    path = "tasks/status/INDEX.md"
    old = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read() if os.path.exists(path) else ""
    if old != out:
        open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(out)
        print("INDEX updated")
    else:
        print("INDEX unchanged")
    print("PROBLEMS:", len(problems))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
